page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon 8163 processor cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng, Geekbench, and single-threaded gzip compression tests placing in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested hardware. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by middle-tier results in multi-threaded stress-ng, PassMark CPU, and bzip3 decompression tests. Memory bandwidth and database operations, including Redis SET transactions and static web serving throughput, also perform within the average range.

Given its resource profile, this instance offers a balanced allocation of compute and memory resources suitable for workloads that benefit from multi-threaded execution rather than high single-core clock speeds. It is appropriate for general-purpose applications, multi-threaded data processing, middle-tier web serving, and moderate database operations. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and standard 1:4 memory-to-vCPU ratio provide predictable resource density for enterprise workloads without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware.
